title: Cyber Metal
style: At 148 BPM, the synthwave-trap fusion kicks in with thick analog bass, neon pads, thumping 808s, and sharp gated snares. Verses blend electric guitar, rapid hi-hats, and bubbling synths. Choruses burst with double-time trap beats, soaring retro synth leads, lush riffs, cinematic strings, swirling arps, water FX, and fluid transitions beneath dynamic vocals. Breakdowns spotlight vintage strings, wavesynth layers, double-kicks, deep sub-bass, and overdriven guitar, evoking a liquid-wave vibe. Trap DJ drops, pulsing melodic guitar, and remix-ready edits inject extra retro-modern punch.
lyrics:
[NARRATOR — NOT SUNG | cinematic voiceover]
(SFX: planetary tremor, plasma thunder, warning sirens.)
(Scene: scorched battlefield—sky裂 with neon-pink lightning.)
(Camera: wide—colossal shadow shrinks... condenses... focuses.)

(Beat: intro = sub-quake rumble + distant impacts + sparse ticking hats)

[XENG — MALE LEAD | sung, low awe]
When gods decide to walk this plane
They don’t roar first... they aim.
Size fades down—power stays
A universe learns fear today.

[DRAGONZILLA — MONSTER VOX | low chant, reverbed]
...Compression complete...
God-Mode—active.

(Drums: Pattern A = kick...kick | snare | kick | snare, ultra-deep 808 weight)

[DRAGONZILLA — MONSTER VOX]
Jet-black scales—plasma veins
Pink eyes burn—perfect aim.
Human-size—no wasted mass
Every step—calculated wrath.
“Ooooh...”—targets lock and freeze
Fear spikes faster than disease.

[NARRATOR — NOT SUNG]
(SFX: comic-panel impact.)
Caption: “When destruction learns precision, extinction follows.”

(Build: choir swell + bass-key pulse + rising alarms)

[XENG — MALE LEAD | sung, controlled pride]
He doesn’t need the sky to fall
He brings the end—efficient, small.
A kaiju mind inside a blade
Every breath a doomsday made.

(Drums: Pattern B = double-kick bursts + rolling triplet hats)

[DRAGONZILLA — COMBO CALL | chanted rhythm]
Claw—slash—BERSERKER!
Tail surge—THUNDER WHIP!
“Ouch!”—armor melts—shatter!
Screams!—no cover—slip!

[DRAGONZILLA — MONSTER VOX]
Plasma claws from hand to feet
I carve paths reality can’t heal.
Moans in pains—yes, I hear
That’s the sound of extinction near.

[CHORUS — FULL DROP | massive, chant-driven]
Dragonzilla—God-Mode awake
Every heartbeat—earthquake.
Shrink the form—expand the end
This is how all wars bend.
Dragonzilla—don’t look away
Pink plasma fate—on delay.
If you’re marked, it’s already done
Run if you want—there is none.

(DJ Remix: hook loop “God-Mode” + distortion + sub drops + stutter vox)

[ALICE — FEMALE SERAPH | stunned but composed]
His energy output exceeds projections...
By orders of magnitude.

[SNAPPY — GRITTY HYBRID | impressed]
Yeah... I’m not standing there.

[DANTE — DARK BARITONE | dark approval]
Even hell gives this one space.

[STARCRAFT — AI VOICE | robotic, alert]
TARGETING SYSTEMS SYNCHRONIZED.
TRILLION-LOCK CONFIRMED.

(Breakbeat switch = short amen cut → silence → slam back into trap)

[DRAGONZILLA — NAMED MOVES | thunderous chant]
VOID-SUNDER CLAW — PLASMA RIP!
“Ooooh!”—defenses slip!
TAIL-SPIKE SURGE — PINK LIGHTNING LASH!
“Screams!”—battlefield flash!
BERSERKER CLAW ARRAY — BLACKSKY SHRED!
Mountains kneel—cities dread!

[DRAGONZILLA — ULTIMATE | slow, absolute]
TRILLION-LOCK APOCALYPSE —
HOMING PLASMA PINK LIGHTNING FIREBALL SWARM!

(SFX: cascading detonations across the horizon.)

Enemies: “AAAHH!” “Ooooh!” “Moans in pains!” — silence.

[FINAL CHORUS — BIGGEST | layered chants + lead]
Dragonzilla—God-Mode reign
Precision turns the world to flame.
Human-size—cosmic reach
No king escapes—no god can teach.
If extinction needs a name
The answer’s written in pink flame.

[OUTRO — low rumble, fading choir]
(SFX: energy cooling; distant thunder.)
[DRAGONZILLA — MONSTER VOX | quiet]
...Targets... eliminated.
